title: Nested chart orientations equal the ordered affine composites
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be smooth separated morphisms of pure relative dimensions $d,e\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and put $h=gf$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

Fix $r\ge1$ and $R=\mathbf Z/\ell^r$. Work in the ordinary constant-$R$ pro-etale derived categories, their bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories [det-sp-finite-general-ring], derived tensor/pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-tensor] and Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. For $w=f,g,h$ put $\omega_w=G_wR$, $G_w=w^!$, $L_w=R(d_w)[2d_w]$, with $d_f=d,d_g=e,d_h=d+e$. Use the inverse diagonal orientations $a_w:L_w\simeq\omega_w$, counit-defined tensor maps $t_{w,K}$, and exceptional compositor $c:G_h\simeq G_fG_g$ [def-pur-smooth-purity-map, def-pur-co-smoothness, det-sp-composition-comparisons].

Let $S\subset Z,V\subset g^{-1}S,U\subset f^{-1}V$ be affine opens and let $v:V\to\mathbf A^e_S$, $u:U\to\mathbf A^d_V$ be separated etale maps of finite presentation with $g|_V=p_{e,S}v$, $f|_U=p_{d,V}u$ [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sbc-affine-space]. Put $b=\mathbf A^d(v)$ and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$; identify $h|_U=p_{d+e,S}bu$ in that coordinate order. Denote by $\Gamma_{p_m,H}:p_m^*H(m)[2m]\to G_{p_m}H$ the ordered affine integration-transposed comparisons, with $\Gamma_{p_0,H}=1_H$ and the recursive line normalization of [lem-pur-projection-purity-agreement]. Then, under the canonical open restriction, etale $u^!=u^*$, $v^!=v^*$, tensor/base-change and counit-preserving composition identifications,
$$j^*(c_1a_h)=(bu)^*\bigl(c^{\mathrm{aff}}_1\Gamma_{p_{d+e,S},R}\bigr),$$
$$j^*\!\left(t_{f,\omega_g}(f^*a_g\otimes a_f)\right)=(bu)^*\!\left(\Gamma_{p_d,G_{p_e}R}\circ p_d^*(\Gamma_{p_e,R})(d)[2d]\right).$$
Here $p_e:\mathbf A^e_S\to S$, $p_d:\mathbf A^d_{\mathbf A^e_S}\to\mathbf A^e_S$, and $c^{\mathrm{aff}}:G_{p_{d+e}}\simeq G_{p_d}G_{p_e}$ is the same adjunction-normalized compositor. The displayed right sides agree for all $d,e\ge0$. Thus the two displayed restricted arrows agree. The formulas use $a_{p_m}=\Gamma_{p_m,R}$ and $\Gamma_{p_m,H}=t_{p_m,H}(1\otimes\Gamma_{p_m,R})$ also for $H=G_{p_e}R$; every such input is constructible finite-Tor. The coordinate block interchange is the even-degree sign $(-1)^{(2d)(2e)}=1$, and if a block is empty its comparison is the tensor-unit identity.

proof.text: Use the shared unchanged constructions and their four already proved geometric helpers. Instantiate nested_affine_normalized_inputs. Apply nested_affine_chart_formulas to obtain lhs = aff and rhs = it for each compact-support normalization. These two equations do not yet identify aff with it.

Instantiate nested_affine_integration_regrouping on S. Pull its equality back by chartPull, by substituting equal arguments in this actual function. Then lhs = aff = it = rhs by transitivity. This retains the exact common target, sources, compactification comparisons and zero-rank cases of Statement.

Prove the final two finite-Tor assertions directly by the adopted ordinary-etale constructibleFiniteTor_rightDerivedUpperShriek theorem at the coefficient unit and constructibleFiniteTor_leftDerivedUpperStar along f. The field structure map makes the finite coefficient exponent invertible (finiteComparedInvertibleExponent), and the coefficient unit is constructible finite-Tor (chartCoefficientUnit_finiteTor). These are already proved ordinary APIs underlying exceptional finite-Tor preservation and pullback stability; the condensed/pro-etale presentations are not needed for these ordinary output clauses.
The exponent (2d)(2e) is even: it is (2d) times 2e and 2d is even. Even.neg_one_pow proves the sign is one. Assemble all nine conjuncts of Statement.
